summary: Frontend regression testing of /basvuru step-1 traveler validation fixes. All 6 requested scenarios pass: (1) blocking incomplete traveler with amber notice, (2) two-step remove confirm + fill-scroll, (3) family-discount pending state, (4) happy path single traveler advances after AI OCR upload, (5) duplicate documents block with red banner + per-traveler warning, (6) mobile 390px regression (no horizontal scroll, action bar & notice render, blocks progression).

test1_block_with_notice.empty_traveler_copy_present: 'hiçbir bilgi girilmemiş. Bu yolcuyu kullanmayacaksanız kaldırın.' rendered for 2. Yolcu
test1_block_with_notice.notice_text_sample: Eksik yolcu bilgisi · devam edemiyoruz; 1. Yolcu · ALI TEST — eksik: Doğum Tarihi, Pasaport numarası, Pasaport geçerlilik tarihi, Pasaport fotoğrafı, Vesikalık fotoğraf

test3_family_discount_meter_pending.pending_text_sample: 2 yolcunun pasaport veya vesikalık belgesi eksik. Aile indirimi, en az 2 yolcunun pasaportu ve fotoğrafı yüklendiğinde uygulanır.

test5_duplicate_block.block_text: Aynı pasaport veya vesikalık birden fazla yolcuda kullanılmış (2. yolcu). Her yolcu için kendi belgelerini yükleyin.
test5_duplicate_block.traveler_1_warning_text: Dikkat: 1. yolcuyla aynı pasaport numarası. Her yolcu için kendi pasaportunu ve vesikalığını ekleyin; aynı belgeyle devam edemezsiniz.
test5_duplicate_block.family_discount_meter_state: %10 aktif (acceptable per test spec - duplicate block is what prevents submission)

test6_mobile_390px.note: First playwright force-click on mobile-next-step-button appeared to no-op once (likely browser event timing); native JS .click() and subsequent runs all fire correctly. Element is not covered - elementFromPoint at button center returns the button itself. Not a real user-facing bug.

critical_code_review_comments: Apply.jsx is 4306 lines - exceeds the 700-line guideline; strongly recommend splitting into per-step subcomponents (Step1Personal, Step2Visa, Step3Extras, Step4Payment) and extracting duplicate/incomplete-travelers logic to hooks for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. Test only created transient draft rows in MongoDB (harmless per E1).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All bug fixes on Apply.jsx step-1 validation verified working. testids used: input-contact-name/email/phone, add-adult-traveler-button, wizard-next-step-button, mobile-next-step-button, wizard-progress-label, incomplete-travelers-notice, incomplete-traveler-{idx}, incomplete-traveler-{idx}-fill, incomplete-traveler-{idx}-remove, incomplete-traveler-{idx}-remove-confirm, family-discount-meter, family-discount-active-badge, family-discount-pending-text, family-discount-add-traveler, step1-document-block-warning, traveler-{idx}-duplicate-warning, traveler-{idx}-passport-ai-input, traveler-{idx}-photo-upload-input. Uploads /app/frontend/public/passport-guide/ok.jpg and /app/frontend/public/photo-guide/ok.jpg pass AI OCR/photo checks and populate name/passport-no automatically (~20-30s). If mobile-next-step-button appears not to fire under playwright, retry using page.evaluate(()=>btn.click()).
